name: What should I look for in a contractor for senior home modifications?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a contractor for senior home modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for senior home modifications, look for experience in accessible design and aging-in-place projects. Verify their licensing and insurance. Request references from previous clients with similar projects and review their portfolio. A good contractor should communicate clearly, understand specific accessibility needs, and provide a detailed proposal and contract. Prioritize those who demonstrate empathy and expertise in senior living solutions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a contractor with experience in accessible design, proper licensing, insurance, and strong references. They should demonstrate clear communication and empathy for senior-specific needs.
